# std.test

<!-- Generated by `lang doc std` from the checked interfaces (lang 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Assertions and controlled-runtime fixtures for tests: a controlled clock,
seeded randomness (`std.random`), controlled scheduling with
record/replay of interleavings, and property checks.

## Functions

### `advance`

```lang
fn advance(d: Duration) -> Unit
```

Advance the controlled clock.

### `assert_eq`

```lang
fn assert_eq<T>(actual: T, expected: T) -> Unit where T: Eq, T: Display
```

Fail the current test unless `actual == expected`.

### `assert_true`

```lang
fn assert_true(condition: Bool, message: String) -> Unit
```

### `expect_err`

```lang
fn expect_err<T, E>(r: Result<T, E>) -> E
```

Fail unless `r` is an error.

### `explore`

```lang
fn explore<E>(runs: Int, body: fn() -> Result<Unit, E>) -> Unit where E: Display
```

Run `body` under `runs` scheduling seeds. A failing interleaving fails
the test with its seed and recorded decisions, which `replay_schedule`
reproduces.

### `fail`

```lang
fn fail(message: String) -> Never
```

### `fifo_schedule`

```lang
fn fifo_schedule() -> Unit
```

Return to first-in first-out scheduling.

### `manual_clock`

```lang
fn manual_clock(start_nanos: Int) -> Unit
```

Switch `time.now()` to a controlled clock starting at `start_nanos`.

### `property`

```lang
fn property<T, E>(runs: Int, seed: Int, gen: fn(random.Random) -> T, check: fn(T) -> Result<Unit, E>) -> Unit where T: Display, E: Display
```

A behavioral (property) check: `check` must hold for `runs` values made
by `gen` from seeded random sources (`seed`, `seed + 1`, ...). A failure
reports the value and the seed that regenerates it.

### `real_clock`

```lang
fn real_clock() -> Unit
```

Return to the real monotonic clock.

### `record_schedule`

```lang
fn record_schedule() -> Unit
```

Start recording the scheduling decisions made from now on.

### `recorded_schedule`

```lang
fn recorded_schedule() -> List<Int>
```

The decisions recorded so far (indices into the ready queue).

### `replay_schedule`

```lang
fn replay_schedule(decisions: List<Int>) -> Unit
```

Replay recorded decisions (then continue first-in first-out).

### `schedule_seed`

```lang
fn schedule_seed(seed: Int) -> Unit
```

Controlled scheduling (single worker): pick among ready tasks
pseudo-randomly from `seed` instead of first-in first-out. Combined with
a controlled clock and seeded randomness, an interleaving is
reproducible from its seed. `LANG_SCHED_SEED` sets it for every test.
